eclipse.platform.text

Change-Id: Idde1f2518de4a8d94305afb6cf29a1892418ade0
Signed-off-by: Lars Vogel <Lars.Vogel@vogella.com>
dslRule:
<!id: modernize.stringbufferToBuilder>
<!description: Replace StringBuffer with StringBuilder for local variables for performance, as StringBuilder is not synchronized. This is only safe for local variables not shared across threads.>
<!severity: WARNING>
new java.lang.StringBuffer($args$) :: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=> new java.lang.StringBuilder($args$)
;;
summary: Replaced new StringBuffer() with new StringBuilder() for local variable initializations to improve performance.

commitMessage:
Bug 519934 - [Generic Editor] allow stateful extensions

Currently, the way extension points and registry are implemented and
used make that the same extension (ie same PresentationReconciler) is
used for all instances of the Generic Editor that match the
content-type.
As all known extensions so far manage to be stateless and as most APIs
are designed to not need the class to keep state, this wasn't much of an
issue.
However, the introduction of reconciler and some use-cases related to it
have highlighted that some classes need to be stateful, and that there
is nothing that  enforce them be be stateless. So we need the Generic
Editor to assume by default that classes are stateful, and to provide a
distinct instance of the extension for each editor instance.

Added async proposal filtering to avoid defaulting to sync proposal
retrieval

Change-Id: Ibdc3767359e7fe6f4ff8d52d8cd895e1ddea04ae
Signed-off-by: Lucas Bullen <lbullen@redhat.com>
Also-By: Mickael Istria <mistria@redhat.com>
dslRule:
<!id: string.substring_negative_start_index_check>
<!description: Add bounds check for substring start index to prevent StringIndexOutOfBoundsException. Ensures the offset is not less than the substring length, for expressions like string.substring(offset - length, offset).>
<!severity: WARNING>
$str.length() >= $len && $str.substring($offset - $len, $offset).equals($compareTo) :: isLiteral($len)
=>
$str.length() >= $len && $offset >= $len && $str.substring($offset - $len, $offset).equals($compareTo)
;;
summary: Adds a missing bounds check 'offset >= length' to String.substring calls within an 'if' condition where 'substring(offset - length, offset)' is used, preventing StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.

dslRule:
<!id: collections.filterNullsOnAssignment>
<!description: Filter null elements from a List assigned to a field from a constructor parameter using streams and Objects.nonNull. This makes the field's list robust against potential null entries in the input list.>
<!severity: HINT>
$field = $param; :: isField($field) && isParameter($param) && instanceof($field, "java.util.List") && instanceof($param, "java.util.List")
=> $field = $param.stream().filter(java.util.Objects.nonNull).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());
;;
summary: Filter nulls from a List assigned to a field from a constructor parameter.

commitMessage:
Bug 527018 - [refactoring] Replace use of Number constructors by valueOf

Change-Id: Ieb6a5450b76c7a5305678f09ecb3785a7fe90c47
Signed-off-by: Karsten Thoms <karsten.thoms@itemis.de>
dslRule:
<!id: prefer-valueOf-for-wrappers>
<!description: Replace primitive wrapper constructors with their static valueOf factory methods for improved performance (caching) and to avoid deprecated API usage.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: performance, modern-java>
<!map WRAPPER_TYPES: "java.lang.Long" => "java.lang.Long", "java.lang.Integer" => "java.lang.Integer", "java.lang.Double" => "java.lang.Double", "java.lang.Float" => "java.lang.Float", "java.lang.Character" => "java.lang.Character">

new #{WRAPPER_TYPES}( $arg )
=>
#{WRAPPER_TYPES_VALUE}.valueOf( $arg )
;;
summary: Replace primitive wrapper constructors with valueOf factory methods.
